maya: Quick mini-scorecard for the new sparrow-lite bring-up. TL;DR: int4 looks like the best unit-econ win for short/chaty queries (~55% cost down) but we see a small quality drop on longform summarization slices. Sharing raw numbers below so we can decide routing + rollout. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

chris: paste the numbers pls (just the key ones)

maya: here are the slice-level aggregates (synthetic traffic sample, 50k tokens):
```
model           | mode   | tokens/s | p50 ms | p95 ms | $/1M tokens | quality delta
sparrow-lite fp16| chat  | 220      | 38     | 120    | $9.8        | baseline
sparrow-lite int8 | chat  | 190      | 34     | 110    | $6.5        | -0.7% (NLL/QA)
sparrow-lite int4 | chat  | 215      | 36     | 130    | $4.4        | -1.9% (NLL/QA)
sparrow-lite int4 | long  | 95       | 120    | 420    | $4.4        | -4.8% (ROUGE/longf)
```
notes: int4 latency is fine for short turns but KV cache perf + p95 tails worsen on >2k token contexts.

jamal: thanks. My read: good candidate for hybrid routing. Quick proposal:
- chat/assist routes -> int4 (default)
- longform / summarization -> int8
- critical flows (billing/consent/legal) -> fp16 only
- add a soft-fallback: if int4 confidence/likelihood drops by >2x, route to int8 for regen
also add a canary with 5% traffic and a 24h signal check (hallucination, perplexity, end-to-end metric)

product-lead: @maya can you estimate the monthly token-econ impact if GTN adopts int4 for chat? assume GTN generates ~10M tokens/day and we route 20% of GTN traffic to int4 in week 1, ramp to 60% by week 4.

maya: quick calc (rounded):
- baseline cost @ fp16: $9.8 / 1M tokens -> daily = (10M * 1) * $9.8 / 1M = $98/day
- if 20% of GTN -> int4 at $4.4, blended day1 cost = 0.8*$98 + 0.2*(10M*$4.4/1M)= $78.4 + $8.8 = $87.2 -> ~$10/day saved initially
- at 60% int4 -> blended cost ≈ 0.4*$98 + 0.6*$44 = $39.2 + $26.4 = $65.6 -> ~$32/day saved vs baseline
- projected monthly (30d) at steady 60% -> ~ $960 savings/month for that GTN stream.
Caveat: numbers ignore embedding/rerank overhead and downstream infra CPU variability.

chris: plan for signals and evals:
- sentinel prompt set (2k prompts) run daily against a rolling sample
- track: hallucination rate, exact-match on key GTN intents, latency p95, token cost
- alert if hallucination > 1.5x baseline OR quality delta > 2% absolute for GTN SLAs
- canary config: 5% -> 20% -> 60% over 7 days with manual hold at each step

ops-bot: Canary started: sparrow-lite-int4 on cluster redwood-ded-3, traffic=5% (initiated by chris) :rocket:

jamal: also request: add a daily eval job that samples 2k longform items to make sure we don't silently regress. If any longform slice shows >3% ROUGE drop, pause routing and notify #product and #eng-ml.

maya: will assemble a 1-page GTN handoff: scorecard + proposed routing flags + a short snippet for Console rollout. Draft will include the above numbers, recommended canary steps, and suggested alerts. tagging @product-lead for review.

product-lead: perfect. please include a short A/B script we can run: 5k users split vs control, measure task-complete rate + NPS. want to avoid any surprise UX regressions.

maya: ack — adding A/B script and PR to docs. Will post the brief in #product and link here.

chris: small ops note: when enabling routing flag, set "max_consecutive_failures=3" and "route_fallback=int8" to keep UX safe. Also capture kv-cache evictions for >1k contexts.

ops-bot: Canary update (24h): traffic=5%, hallucination delta +0.2% (within bounds), latency p95 +3%. No holds.

maya: thanks everyone — next steps: I'll push the GTN brief, create the sentinel eval job, and open the routing flag PR. Back here once PR is ready. :white_check_mark:
